columns.name: SKILL_NAME
columns.description: This is the name of the skill that has been identified for a particular user.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: This is the description of the skill that has been identified for a particular user.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: This represents the Fusion id of the user for which this skill was found.

columns.name: IS_SEEDED
columns.description: This indicates whether the skill was seeded or not seeded.

columns.name: NUM_OF_OCCURRENCES
columns.description: This represents the number of times a particular skill has been found for a particular user.

columns.name: IS_REJECTED
columns.description: This indicates whether the skill was rejected or not. 0 --> Undecided, 1--> True/Rejected the skill, 2 --> False/Accepted the skill

columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.
